title: Workforce Housing Developers
short_description: Developer sought for 12–15 affordable single-family homes on donated land in Floyd, Virginia.
project_scope: Development of 12 to 15 single-family, detached, owner-occupied homes on a donated parcel for households earning 55% to 150% of area median income. The notice indicates a workforce housing development project with planning, redevelopment planning, and design-build/developer scope.
services: Design-build/developer services; housing and urban development; planning/master planning; redevelopment planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Residential housing development with standard single-family homes, not a structurally complex or special structure.
- Primarily developer and planning scope rather than structural engineering for bridges, roofs, stadiums, or complex buildings.
- Small overall scale and low stated construction cost.
- Limited fit with sbp's focus on lightweight, innovative, or architecturally demanding structures.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning or engineering fee is stated. The notice only gives a total construction cost of $1.0M and requests developer/design-build and planning-related services.
references_qualifications: Housing development partner/developer qualifications implied; disciplines requested include design-build/developer, housing and urban development, planning/master planning, and redevelopment planning. No specific reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
